scientific_integrity: The analytical character-fiber proof establishes the infinite family and limiting mean. Finite-field code checks eleven field instances independently at the coefficient level; tests are not presented as infinite proof. The classical three-step random-walk mean is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas apply to the quartic monomial graph (x,y,xy^3) on finite fields, not all monomial graphs. The universal split-branch asymptotic requires prime characteristic tending to infinity. Absolute publication priority is not proved.
title: Cubic-fiber splitting and the three-step-walk constant in finite Fourier projection norms
